headline: Tohoku Electric's Container-Type Data Center “Miyagi AI Data Center” Completed, Offering Housing Services for Next-Generation GPU Servers
summary: Tohoku Electric held an opening ceremony on July 31 for its container-type Miyagi AI Data Center, built with GetWorks. It will house next-generation GPU servers.
why: Tohoku Electric is a major Japanese regional utility, and data centers are a growing source of electricity demand driven by AI computing. Its expansion into hosting services shows utilities moving into digital infrastructure.
